messages:
incident-bot: Pager — DedPool 'orbit' node gpu-7: BMC sensor_read_fail (thermal). Automatic drain started for tenants on gpu-7. Severity: P2. Link: https://infra.ops/inc/3605550000
oncall-ml: On call, ack. Moving to incident thread. Assigning SRE.
sre-jamie: Taking the pager. Observed BMC logs show sensor returning 0.0C intermittently, ECC counters spiking on GPU7. Starting graceful drain now.
eng-ops-lee: Copy. Sending drain command: `rpool drain --node gpu-7 --reason "bmc_sensor_fail"`
sre-jamie: Drain kicked. Current running workloads for tenant-ten23: 3 active streams, 1 long-run eval. Trying live KV cache migration; if fail we'll fallback.
eng-runtime-maria: I'll pre-create fallback route to redwood-v2-small for tenant-ten23 and add rate-limits to avoid spike.
customer-success-anna: Notifying Orbit Analytics (ten23) via email and phone — they prefer graceful drain, approved short fallback if needed.
vendor-bot: Hardware ticket created with provider INC-ORB-8921. ETA on replacement node: ~2.5 hrs.
eng-hardware-sam: BMC indicates 'sensor_read_fail' and transient I2C error. Requesting remote power-cycle. Advise caution with live migration.
sre-jamie: Attempting live migration of KV cache -> status: partial copy 60%.
oncall-ml: If migration stalls >5m, cutover to fallback. Keep CS updated.
sre-jamie: Migration stalled, evicting remaining tasks. Issuing fallback for affected requests: route to redwood-v2-small now.
eng-runtime-maria: Fallback route in place, verified 200 OK from health checks. Token throughput throttled to 70%.
customer-success-anna: Orbit confirmed degraded performance but no data loss. They requested ETA and impact window to send to their ops team.
sre-jamie: Node drain completed, tenants evicted. Node state: quarantined. Marking as untrusted. BMC power cycle attempted, no change.
eng-hardware-sam: Escalating for RMA. Replacement scheduled for next maintenance window; temporary hot-swap unit available in DC, ETA 3 hrs.
vendor-bot: Provider acknowledged hardware RMA INC-ORB-8921 -> in progress.
sre-jamie: Handoff to hardware oncall. I'll update incident status to 'mitigated' and assign followup INF-3621 for postmortem and docs.
customer-success-anna: Sending summary to Orbit: short disruption, fallback applied, no retries lost, replacement scheduled. They asked for postmortem.
sre-jamie: Thanks all. Incident mitigated :white_check_mark:. Will close thread after postmortem assigned.
